newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IOC BUYS 40,000/T SEPT LPG, RETENDERS FOR 18,000/T.
newsitem.headline: IOC BUYS 40,000/T SEPT LPG, RETENDERS FOR 18,000/T.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) bought 40,000-tonnes of butane in a tender for September delivery to the east coast, industry sources said on Tuesday.
IOC did not award its tender for butane for delivery to the west coast due to lack of offers. Instead the company reissued a new tender for butane and propane, they said.

IOC bought three cargoes of around 13,000-tonnes each for delivery to Vizag on the east coast at a $3 to $5 per tonne discount to the Saudi benchmark Contract Price, on a free-on-board Middle East basis , the source said.
The award was slightly higer than IOC's August purchases of three cargoes of 13,000 tonnes to Vizag and one 10,000 tonne cargo to Mangalore, on the west coast, at a $5 discount.
The tender which closed August 6 and was valid until August 9, also sought three cargoes of 10,000 tonnes each to Mangalore and Kandla on the west coast.
IOC did not buy any west coast cargoes because it did not receive any offers, an Indian industry source said.

As a result, it issued a fresh tender for two cargoes of 10,000 tonnes of butane and a 8,000-tonne of propane and/or a butane or propane combination cargo of 18,000-tonnes for delivery to Kandla between September 1-21, traders said.
The tender closes August 13 and is valid for a day.
